empty.title: No cases yet
empty.description: Once you start or join a case, it will show up in this list.

error.title: We couldn't load your cases
error.description: Check your connection and try again whenever you're ready.

caseDetail.privacyNotice: Your private positions are never shared with the other party. They will only see what you choose to propose.

awaitingCounterparty.title: Waiting for the other party
awaitingCounterparty.description: Once the other party joins the case, you'll be able to move forward with the negotiation.

positions.title: My private positions
positions.supportingCopy: Only you can see this information. The other party will not have access to your values or conditions.

basicInfo.title: Start a new case
basicInfo.subtitle: First, add a reference that helps you recognize it. The other party will see the name and description.
basicInfo.nameError: Enter a name for the case
basicInfo.descriptionHint: Don't include private positions or sensitive information.

method.title: Choose the resolution method
method.subtitle: You can change this later if the case needs it.

descriptions.negociacion: The parties exchange proposals and look for a point of agreement.
descriptions.conciliacion: The process includes guidance to bring the positions closer together.
descriptions.mediacion: A neutral third party supports the dialogue and helps reach an agreement.

review.title: Review the information
review.privacyReminder: Positions and agreement ranges are loaded privately afterward.

invite.title: Invite the other party
invite.subtitle: Choose how you'd like to share access to this case.

link.title: Link
link.description: Share an invitation link through whichever channel you prefer.

codigo.title: Code
codigo.description: Share a short code so the other party can join.

email.title: Email
email.description: We'll prepare the invitation for the email address you provide.

invite.sandboxMessage: The invitation was recorded in the test environment.

success.title: The case is ready
success.body: The invitation is ready. Once the other party joins, you'll be able to continue the process.

dashboard.title: My private positions
dashboard.supportingCopy: Only you can see this information. The other party will not have access to your values or conditions.

ineligible.title: Not available yet
ineligible.description: You'll be able to add your private positions once the other party joins the case.

empty.title: No positions yet
empty.description: Add the topics you want to resolve and privately define what agreement range you'd consider.

category.privacyHint: The category is also private until a proposal is generated.

cuidado_ninos.label: Care for children and adolescents
cuidado_ninos.description: Day-to-day care arrangements, with no identifying details about minors.

bienes.label: Assets
bienes.description: Division or use of material assets.

economico.label: Economic matters
economico.description: Amounts, payments, or other economic values.

personalizado.label: Another topic
personalizado.description: Any other matter you'd like to resolve.

basicInfo.nameError: Enter a name for this position

range.hint: You can write an amount, frequency, or condition, depending on the topic.
range.privacyText: Your range is private. The other party won't see these values.
range.minExceedsMaxError: The minimum can't be greater than the maximum

concession.sectionTitle: Could you concede on this topic?
concession.canConcedeDescription: You're willing to move from your initial position.
concession.cannotConcedeTitle: Could not concede on this topic
concession.cannotConcedeDescription: This point has no room for negotiation for you.
concession.conditionsHint: This information is private and helps generate proposals without revealing your limits.

review.title: Review your position
review.privacyBody: Only you can review this data. The shared proposal will not show your original values.

delete.title: Delete position
delete.body: Do you want to delete "{{name}}"? This can't be undone in this test session.

create.title: Describe your position
create.subtitle: Fill in each section with the information you'd like to share privately.

waitingCounterparty.title: Waiting for the other party
waitingCounterparty.description: Once the other party joins the case, you'll be able to start negotiating.

positionsIncomplete.title: Your positions are missing
positionsIncomplete.description: Complete your private positions to take part in the next proposal.

waitingOtherParty.title: Waiting for the other party to be ready
waitingOtherParty.description: You can't generate a shared proposal yet.

ready.title: Ready to negotiate
ready.description: You can now generate a shared proposal for this round.

inProgressPending.title: Proposal waiting for your response
inProgressPending.description: There's a shared proposal ready for you to review.

inProgressWaiting.title: Waiting for the other party
inProgressWaiting.description: You've already responded. The other party's response is still pending.

completedNoAgreement.title: Round completed without agreement
completedNoAgreement.description: You can continue in a new round with another alternative.

agreementReached.title: You reached an agreement
agreementReached.description: Both parties accepted the shared proposal.

readOnly.title: Negotiation closed
readOnly.description: This case no longer accepts new proposals or responses.

dashboard.title: Negotiation
dashboard.privacyNotice: Your private positions are never shown in the negotiation. The other party won't see your values.

generate.generatingBody: The AI is organizing a shared alternative from the information available.
generate.privacyNote: Private positions are not shown in the proposal.

response.waitingOther: Your response has been recorded. You'll see the outcome once the other party responds.

accept.title: Accept this proposal?
accept.body: Your response will be recorded. The agreement only moves forward if both parties accept.

reject.title: Not accept this proposal?
reject.body: You'll be able to continue in a new round with another alternative.

resolution.agreementBody: Both parties accepted the shared proposal.
resolution.notAcceptedBody: The proposal wasn't accepted by both parties. You can continue in a new round.

mediator.title: You can request support
mediator.body: From this round on, a human mediator can support the dialogue.

empty.title: No completed rounds yet
empty.description: Once a round is completed, it will show up here.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.description: We're still working on this section. There's nothing to show here yet.
